series.name: Arc 1: Spark
series.logline: In a city where colour is a crime, a girl who has spent her life feeling nothing ignites in public, and the Inkguard's youngest hunter is sent to put her out.
series.format: 5 parts of 45-60 s, manga-panels. Cold open on the peak image, 'Part N' card by ~4 s, one colour moment, cliffhanger, 'Part N+1 →' end card. Payoff in Part 5: Akari burns on purpose and colour floods the market.
series.hookFormula: The forbidden fact, or the broken rule

series.name: Arc 2: Blue Fire
series.logline: The hunter has been hiding a flame of his own. To save him, Akari walks into the Inkguard's tower, where the grey is not paint but erased memories.
series.format: 4 parts of 45-60 s, manga-panels. Two-colour moments (red and blue) allowed in Part 3. Payoff in Part 4: Dai, with no powers, brings Akari back.
series.hookFormula: The betrayal reveal, or the impossible stake

series.name: Arc 3: Ashfall
series.logline: A hundred years ago one girl painted the sky black to end a war of fire. She is Sumi, and the only way to bring back the sun is to burn the Hush from the inside.
series.format: 5 parts of 45-60 s, manga-panels. Every cast colour appears by the finale; Part 5 ends in full colour: the first sunrise in a hundred years.
